energy_accounting.study_energy_disclosure: Direct circuit-board current sensors on edge rails; gate-level circuit figures stay labeled models.

claims.statement: Every calculation is a physical event where flipping switches on silicon spends real electrical energy in joules.
Honest hardware audits separate power-rail current sensors from chip counters, while sleeping at zero clock cycles between jobs.
Single-cycle Boolean lookup circuits replace power-hungry floating-point arithmetic on repeated decisions with tiny hardware steps.
Headline outcome: 927 Microjoules Shunt Edge · 20x Compile Cut (Direct circuit-board current sensors on edge rails; gate-level circuit figures stay labeled models.)

easy_read.easy_title: Every Digital Bit Spends Real Electricity
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about every digital bit spends real electricity.
Every calculation is a physical event where flipping switches on silicon spends real electrical energy in joules.
Honest hardware audits separate power-rail current sensors from chip counters, while sleeping at zero clock cycles between jobs.
Single-cycle Boolean lookup circuits replace power-hungry floating-point arithmetic on repeated decisions with tiny hardware steps.
Key result: 927 Microjoules Shunt Edge · 20x Compile Cut.
Real power sensors on the circuit board measured the electricity.
